subject: System
action: WHEN the chapter editor screen has not finished loading the chapter record, the textarea must remain disabled.
condition: The screen has mounted and the chapter load has not completed.
expectedOutcome: Editing is blocked until loaded becomes true after the fetch completes.

subject: System
action: WHEN the user clicks 발행하기, the screen must call publishChapterAction(workId, chapterId, isPaid ? (priceTier ?? PRICE_TIERS[0]) : null), using null for a free chapter and a paid tier selected from PRICE_TIERS when paid.
condition: The user initiates publishing from the chapter editor screen.
expectedOutcome: The publish request carries either no price tier for free publication or one of the allowed paid tiers for paid publication.

subject: System
action: WHEN the user clicks 회차 저장, the screen must submit the current content through saveChapterContentAction(workId, chapterId, content) and show toast.success('저장했어요.') on success or toast.error(result.error ?? '저장하지 못했어요. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.') on failure.
condition: The user activates the save control from the chapter editor screen.
expectedOutcome: The current chapter content is submitted and the UI gives success or failure feedback by toast.

subject: System
action: WHEN the user clicks 발행 취소, the screen must require confirmation in a dialog before calling unpublishChapterAction(workId, chapterId).
condition: The user attempts to unpublish a chapter from the editor screen.
expectedOutcome: The chapter is not unpublished unless the user confirms, after which the dialog closes and the unpublish action runs.

subject: System
action: WHEN unpublishChapterAction(workId, chapterId) completes, the screen must set isPublished to false and show a success toast on success, or show the error toast fallback on failure.
condition: The user confirmed 발행 취소 and the unpublish request returns.
expectedOutcome: The UI reflects unpublish success or failure through published-state update and toast feedback.

subject: System
action: WHEN the user interacts with mentions or the AI panel, the screen must apply the visible client-side guards for mention deduplication, caret-based autocomplete, blocked sends during active generation or empty trimmed input, and proposal save availability only when a proposal exists and no other save is in progress.
condition: The user is using mention insertion or AI proposal controls in the chapter editor screen.
expectedOutcome: The UI limits mention and AI actions to the states explicitly allowed by the screen rules.
